sql.title: SQL query
sql.description: A single SELECT statement against Dataverse, using table and column logical names (e.g. SELECT TOP 10 name, ownerid FROM account WHERE statecode = 0). Supports JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, TOP, DISTINCT, IN (SELECT ...) and JSON_VALUE. Headless (MCP) calls run SELECT only and reject INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE. When the tool window is opened with it, the statement is put into the editor and not run: the user reviews it and runs it, and INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE go through the usual preview and confirmation.

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: Headless (MCP) calls only: maximum number of rows to return (default 500, at most 5000). moreRecords is true when more rows exist; narrow the query or use TOP.
